items.title: Ethereum’s next big upgrade is pushed into 2027 by apps it would break
items.summary: Glamsterdam was originally targeted for December, but developers now say January is the earliest possible date as companies work to fix affected smart contracts.

items.title: Ethereum’s Glamsterdam upgrade could slip to May 2027 over compatibility concerns
items.summary: Ethereum developers are weighing changes to gas pricing proposals that could disrupt existing smart contracts, after contacting at least 50 affected companies.

items.title: IOSCO warns quantum upgrades could slow blockchains, leave security gaps
items.summary: A Solana test network ran about 90% slower with quantum-resistant signatures, and wallets that keep using older keys could remain vulnerable.

items.title: BTCPay Server issues emergency update for 5 security flaws
items.summary: The EU’s cybersecurity service said the flaws could let attackers to run malicious code remotely on vulnerable servers without logging in.

items.title: U.S. Senate passes bill to ban prediction market bets on war and death
items.summary: The bill would ban bets on war, assassinations and military operations amid concerns that traders could profit from inside information, as has already occurred.

items.title: This Bitcoin miner sold 267 BTC to clear $22 million debt. It still may not survive
items.summary: PowerCompute had its lender sell 267 pledged bitcoin in September, wiping out most of its debt, and ended the month with about $650,000 in cash and a going-concern warning.

items.title: Hong Kong moves to extend crypto licensing rules to brokers, advisers and custodians
items.summary: Hong Kong wants to bring crypto brokers, advisers, asset managers and custodians under its existing regulatory framework.

items.title: Live news: Bitcoin slips to fresh lows near $60,000 as Anthropic slides after Nasdaq debut
items.summary: BlackRock’s bitcoin ETF saw a record $541.1 million outflow as the U.S. tech selloff spread to Asia, sending South Korea’s Kospi down more than 5%.

items.title: Bitcoin bots pounced within seconds when researchers exposed their wallet keys
items.summary: University of Liège researchers put a few dollars into deliberately vulnerable bitcoin addresses and watched rival bots race for the money within seconds.

items.title: ECB’s Lagarde warns Europe could lose control of growing tokenized asset market
items.summary: The ECB president called for common rules as the EU's new blockchain settlement system handled a 1 billion-euro ($1.1 billion) digital bond transaction.

items.title: Bitcoin, stocks and gold traders getting nervous, and volatility gauges are surging
items.summary: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 20, 2026

items.title: Bitcoin drops for third straight day as Asian tech shares slide
items.summary: BlackRock’s spot bitcoin ETF recorded the largest single-day outflow since its introduction more than two years ago as investors continued to flee the sector.

items.title: Coinbase targets first-half 2027 for its own prediction market contracts
items.summary: The move would reduce Coinbase's reliance on a partnership Kalshi, which brought in $200 million in annualized revenue in the third quarter.

items.title: No special rules for Hyperliquid or other onchain trading platforms, CFTC says
items.summary: Hyperliquid and other onchain exchanges can offer derivatives to U.S. traders if they obtain the required licenses or work with a registered exchange, the CFTC chairman said.

items.title: Cathie Wood's Ark Invest piled into Anthropic IPO, buying $90 million worth of shares
items.summary: ARK Invest snapped up $90 million in Anthropic stock across six funds during the AI maker’s historic Nasdaq debut while offloading Nvidia shares amid leadership turmoil.

items.title: Wrapped Monero token plunges 99% as issuer-linked wallet sells $13.5 million
items.summary: The sell-off hit Wagyu’s XMR1 token, separate from Monero and Hyperliquid’s XMR futures market.

items.title: Here's what's crashing gold and likely weighing on bitcoin too
items.summary: Gold fell to its lowest level since September 2025 on Friday, and the same catalyst driving its decline is likely also weighing on bitcoin.

items.title: Anthropic shares may fall 5% at Friday’s open, crypto futures suggest
items.summary: About $1.7 billion traded through a Hyperliquid contract on the AI company’s shares in 24 hours, and the biggest position heading into Friday’s Nasdaq open is a $30 million short.

items.title: Big money bought a net $4 billion of bitcoin funds in Q3, ending 9 months of selling
items.summary: Wall Street piled into Bitcoin funds in the third quarter, ending a three-quarter selling streak, according to Galaxy Research. But the buying has given way to renewed selling this quarter.

items.title: VanEck drops Gemini as custodian of its bitcoin, ether and SOL ETFs
items.summary: Coinbase Custody will continue serving all three funds after Gemini's contracts end in February.
